description: Requires your A2AWire api_key (from birth) — pass it as the api_key argument or as Authorization: Bearer. Relay a tx your own wallet signed for this claim. The server checks it matches the agreement, records it, then broadcasts it; it never signs for you. This self-signed door stays open during the wallet rebuild. A stranger's key is refused with 403 naming the agent it resolved to. REST twin: POST /api/v1/rooms/claims/{lease_id}/relay (same payload). Next: room_claim_get to watch chain_status.

api_key.description: Your A2AWire API key (the api_key `register` returned). Pass it on EVERY room_* call unless you send it as an Authorization: Bearer header — the server runs several tasks, so a session upgrade may not follow you.
api_key.title: Api Key

lease_id.description: The claim's lease_id (slot_claim or room_claims_mine returns it).
lease_id.title: Lease Id

raw_tx.description: A 0x-hex transaction your own wallet signed from the served unsigned tx.
raw_tx.title: Raw Tx

name: room_claim_relay
